texto:
Hello Jim,
I Wake up 6am. Later, I take shower and Brush my hair and dress up. Later, I go to the mess hall and eat Brew with butter and tea. After that, Practice sport with my friends, I love run in the Military Academy. After that, study in the library at 7pm. Later, I go speed in my bed in the barracks at 8pm.

evaluacion.justificacion:
## Justification
Content: The text mentions part of the daily routine ("Wake up 6am", "take shower and Brush my hair and dress up", "go to the mess hall and eat Brew with butter and tea"). It touches upon activities with "Practice sport" and "study in the library", but does not clearly state how often these activities happen. Free time is not explicitly mentioned, and the opinion on whether life in the Military Academy is hard is missing. The text is 65 words long, which is below 80% of the minimum expected length of 100 words (65% of the minimum). Because an essential point is missing (frequency of activities) and the text is short, the reader is only partly informed, corresponding to band 3.
Organization: The text follows the expected format by including a greeting ("Hello Jim") and an informal ending/closure is absent, but a missing ending does not lower the score per institutional criteria. The text is connected using basic linking words ("Later", "After that"), but sentences are short and sometimes abruptly joined with commas. Punctuation has minor errors (e.g., lowercase "I", missing prepositions). This matches band 3: text is connected using basic, high-frequency linking words.
Language: The student uses taught vocabulary ("wake up", "mess hall", "study", "library", "barracks", "Military Academy"). Control of simple grammatical forms is limited, with missing subjects ("Practice sport", "study in the library"), missing articles ("take shower"), and lexical/form errors ("dress up" instead of get dressed, "eat Brew" instead of bread, "go speed" instead of go to sleep). Meaning can still be determined for most parts. This matches band 3: uses basic vocabulary reasonably appropriately and simple grammatical forms with some degree of control, with errors that may impede meaning at times.

## Target grammar
The student attempts to use the present simple and time references, but struggles with control and structure. Examples include "I Wake up 6am" (missing preposition of time) and "I love run in the Military Academy" (missing infinitive/gerund marker "to run").

Scores: Content 3 | Organization 3 | Language 3
